stem: What is a message in the poem "The Tree"?
instruction: Use The Tree to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: Some things in life are not fully appreciated until they are gone.

options.label: G
options.text: The world is sometimes beyond our own understanding.

options.label: H
options.text: Home is where people feel most comfortable to be themselves.

options.label: J
options.text: It is difficult to predict the actions of our neighbors.
